title: TalonMC Cobblemon
description: TalonMC is a growing Minecraft Cobblemon, Prison, Skyblock, Dungeons & Survival network with hundreds of active players and unique content across all four game modes. New to the server? Claim your FREE RANK with /freerank and jump into the action!
body:
💬 Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/talonserver

⚡ Welcome to TalonMC Cobblemon! ⚡

Add Pokémon to your Minecraft world with the official TalonMC Cobblemon modpack! This pack includes Cobblemon, an expansive Pokémon mod, alongside a curated set of QOL and performance mods. The pack is highly optimized, boosts your FPS, and runs smoothly even on low end hardware. We recommend setting your RAM to 4GB.

Join the TalonMC server via the multiplayer section to catch, battle, and trade with thousands of other trainers!

🌍 Your Pokémon Adventure Awaits
Explore vast, vibrant biomes packed with Pokémon, build your dream team, and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate trainer. With our own custom systems and the full Talon twist, this is Cobblemon like you've never played it before.

🔥 Server Features:

* Custom Progression
* Gyms & Trainer Battles
* Legendary Pokémon
* Tournaments
* Breeding System
* Bosses & PokeHunts
* WonderTrade
* Dex Rewards
* Daily Events & Giveaways
* and so much more

🚀 Next-Gen Performance & Visuals
Say goodbye to stuttering and hello to smooth gameplay. We've bundled the best optimization mods to make sure your journey looks as good as it plays.

* Maximized FPS: Sodium, Lithium, ModernFix, ImmediatelyFast, FerriteCore & EntityCulling
* Smart UI & QOL: Better tooltips, advancements, and interface improvements for the info you need instantly
* Optimized out of the box: Pre-configured settings so it just works, even on low end PCs

🤝 The Heart of the Community
You're never training alone. Jump into a thriving community of trainers with server-wide tournaments, trading events, and giveaways happening all the time. Our team pushes constant updates and your feedback shapes what gets built next.

🔗 Connect with Us!
🎮 Server IP: play.talonmc.net
💬 Discord: discord.gg/talonserver
🌐 Website: talonmc.net

The journey of a lifetime is one click away. See you in-game, trainer! ⚡
